_comment: P2-1j. Every screen delta scripts/menus/audit_mn_screen_coverage.py finds
and this project has DECIDED about. Nothing here is silent: an entry must
name the ruling that accepted it, and an entry whose delta no longer
exists fails the run, so a fixed element cannot keep its excuse.
status 'ruled'  a decision exists -- a board row, a plan phase, or a fact
read out of the source itself.
status 'open'   the delta is real and nobody has ruled on it yet. These
are the OWNER'S QUEUE: the audit prints them as [OPEN] and
counts them separately from the ruled ones, and P2-1j's
report packet lists every one. They are allowed to pass
the gate only so the gate can be RED for something new.
A key spelled 're:<pattern>' matches by regex, which is how one decision
stays one entry: 'the ten fighters P2-3 has not produced' is a single
ruling, and ten copies of it would be ten places for it to rot.

entries.reason: The resting emblem. mnTitleMakeLogoNoOpening (mntitle.c:1051) sets its primitive to pure red with SP_TRANSPARENT and mnTitleLogoProcDisplay (:1011) draws it through gDPSetCombineLERP(0,0,0,PRIMITIVE, TEXEL0,0,PRIMITIVE,0, ...) -- a FLAT primitive colour whose only texture contribution is alpha -- at sMNTitleLogoAlpha 0x4C from tic 170 (:374). On an N64 that is a 30% red wash over its whole silhouette, fire included. A DS 16-bit BG bitmap carries ONE alpha bit, so that wash cannot exist in the layer this art lives in: composited at bake time it survived only where an opaque texel lay beneath it -- measured 2026-08-19, 1,243 texels of TITLE_SCREEN, of which 179 are rows 0..6 of the (f2) upper border band at x 202..236, turning near-black RGB5 (2,1,0) into (11,1,0). That 179-texel block is what the owner reported as a transparent RED artifact on the right of the title, and it is the emblem's shadow on whatever happened to be behind it rather than a rendition of the emblem. Bake and runtime evidence: artifacts/visibility/2026-08-19_p2-1L-title-before-pose38.png (412 red pixels in the band, window x 324..370) against 2026-08-19_p2-1L-title-after-settled.png (0).
entries.ruling: P2-1L (1) omitted it and recorded the delta; reinstating it faithfully needs a second layer the DS can alpha-blend (a semi-transparent OBJ, DS OBJ mode 1 with BLDALPHA, over the 102x99 silhouette) which is a new mechanism on a screen already inside its cadence -- OWNER RULING REQUESTED on whether the wash is worth that

entries.reason: The emblem's own animation cels, and P2-1k (d) re-read who draws them: they are dMNTitleLogoAnimSprites, referenced ONLY inside mnTitleMakeLogo's opening-cinematic arm (mntitle.c:1096-1155, gated on scene_prev == nSCKindOpeningNewcomers). This shell always takes mnTitleMakeLogoNoOpening (:1051), which builds the resting FULL sprite alone -- the one this bake ships. They are therefore the INTRO's cels, not the label animation's: P2-1k (d) built the label pop (mnTitleMakeLabels' five animated pieces) from a baked pose table and it needs none of them.
